stage: exposed development, frozen before common-functional predictions
reason: fully shared-orbital limit removes parent-frame redundancy and defines a single reusable ground-program functional
functional: E_common[Palpha,Pbeta] = 0.5 E_F[Palpha,Pbeta] + 0.5 E_Q[Palpha,Pbeta] at the same spin densities
implementation: charge, spin and response center are identical; only the one-body linear field is averaged
objective_change: optimize the averaged functional, rather than average separately optimized energies
initial_state: new common-ground NTO frame of the retained projected reference transition
solver: single spin-pure ROKS orbital KKT, analytic ground-overlap gradient and curvature
qualification: KKT max < 1e-8; target transition overlap >= 0.7; local CSF overlap >= 0.9
identity_test: energy, orbital gradient and Hessian equal the original F/Q average at identical orbitals to < 1e-10
limitations: distinct from the published two-parent optimization contract
